name: Ecwid
description: Ecwid by Lightspeed is an ecommerce platform that enables merchants to launch a standalone store or embed shopping cart widgets into existing websites with zero platform transaction fees.
best_for: Small businesses, creators, and existing website owners wanting to add ecommerce checkout to WordPress, Wix, or custom sites without migrating platforms.
features: Embeddable shopping cart widget for existing websites (WordPress, Wix, Squarespace)
Social selling synchronization across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and WhatsApp
Point-of-sale (POS) integration for in-person retail sales
Automated tax calculations and discount coupon codes
Support for physical products, digital downloads, and recurring subscriptions

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Up to 5 products, customizable instant site, and zero platform transaction fees.

tiers.name: Venture
tiers.notes: Billed annually at $14.08/mo (or $19/mo monthly); adds up to 100 products, digital goods (up to 25GB), and Facebook/Instagram shops.

tiers.name: Business
tiers.notes: Billed annually at $29.08/mo (or $39/mo monthly); adds up to 2,500 products, abandoned cart recovery, and Amazon/eBay marketplace sync.

tiers.name: Unlimited
tiers.notes: Billed annually at $82.50/mo (or $99/mo monthly); adds unlimited products, custom branded mobile app (ShopApp), and POS integration.

pros: Easily embeds into any pre-existing website or CMS without requiring a full site redesign or store migration
Zero platform transaction fees charged by Ecwid across all plan tiers
Multi-channel inventory synchronization spanning social commerce, online marketplaces, and physical POS
cons: Free plan is capped at 5 physical products and excludes digital downloads
Storefront design and layout flexibility is more restricted compared to dedicated full-site builders like Shopify
Advanced SEO URL editing and product filters require upgrading to the Business tier

alternatives.name: Shopify
alternatives.description: An all-in-one hosted commerce platform with its own storefront, checkout, and POS.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants wanting a dedicated, full-featured store rather than an embedded widget.

alternatives.name: PrestaShop
alternatives.description: An open-source self-hosted commerce platform giving merchants full platform ownership.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants wanting full platform ownership and customization.

alternatives.name: WooCommerce
alternatives.description: An open-source ecommerce platform built as a WordPress plugin, giving merchants control over hosting, checkout, and store customization.
alternatives.best_for: Merchants already committed to WordPress who want self-hosted ownership and plugin-level customization rather than an embedded hosted cart.
